en.ammaar-muslim: 1. [1/131] Rijal al-Kashshi: Hamduwayh from Ya`qub b. Yazid from Ibn Abi Umayr from al-Fudhayl and Ibrahim the two sons of Muhammad al-Ash`ari who said:

when the news of the death of Bukayr b. A`yan reached Aba Abdillah عليه السلام, he said: by Allah – Allah has brought him down [placed him] between the messenger of Allah and the commander of the faithful صلوات الله عليهما [as his station in the world to come]
